notes.title: Version 1.1.3
notes.notes: Includes fix for an issue when selecting Enter as the Interaction button caused it to be pressed twice in menus (causing issues such as not being able to select anything anymore in the Options menu).

notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.notes: Includes a fix to the issue of a spawning enemy during the clock puzzle that does not move or can't be killed when in Easy mode.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Small fixes, including:

- Fixed issue with being able to pick up the same object again by clicking too fast
- Fixed issue with not being able to throw spear after having a throw interrupted by an enemy
- Changed to three clock drawings on the clock puzzle door

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Now with difficulty modes!
notes.notes:
- Added new Easy and Hard modes (you can change difficulties at any time during the game, though you'll have to save and reload for it to take effect)
- Medkit heals more health in Easy and Normal difficulties
- Damage dealt by player and enemies scale according to difficulty

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Small bug fixes, including to the issue of being unable the pick up traps again after the trap kills an enemy.

**Originally this update was going to add 120 FPS support, but having the game run at a higher FPS requires a bit more testing to make sure all logic runs as intended. Sorry about that!

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes: Includes fix to an issue where enemies would become frozen during the boss fight.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
There was an issue with Room 6's door not saving its unlocked state properly, so to fix that I had to make some changes that may cause it to become locked again if you haven't finished the doll head puzzle.

But don't worry! If it's locked but you've already used the key on it (so it's not in your inventory), the Room 6 key should spawn again in its original location to be picked up again, and next time you save the game everything should work correctly.

For any further issues, feel free to post here or to email me directly at spacezetagames@gmail.com. This includes sending me save files that may have become "stuck" due to any game-breaking bug so I can try to fix it for you.

Thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes: Includes a fix to the issue where the player was unable to move after closing the inventory during certain times.

notes.title: Release delay
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, I have to announce that Observo's release will have to be delayed - but just a bit! The new release date will be next week!

I'm so sorry that this is on such short notice, but as a solo dev, I'm still learning a lot when it comes to not just game development, but game publishing as well, so please bear with me as I try to deliver the best possible experience to everyone as soon as I can.

I'm sorry, and thank you for your patience!
